title: Australia Post to serve rural and remote communities via Outback Stores
summary:
Australia Post has announced a new partnership with Outback Stores to provide essential postal services across some of Australia’s most remote communities.

Operating alongside Outback Stores, which manages and supports Indigenous-owned community stores in Australia’s most remote Aboriginal and Torres Strait Island locations, 16 Community Postal Agents (CPA) in the Northern Territory, Western Australia and Queensland will give locals convenient access to services, including prepaid satchels, packaging, stamps and the ability to send and receive mail and parcels.
